title: Add the shared MongoDB e2e helper
prompt:
Story S-03 removes the in-memory storage. Every e2e test will run against MongoDB on the server named by MONGO_TEST_URI. This task builds the one shared e2e helper that the other e2e tasks (S03-04 to S03-07, S03-09) build on. Work only in backend/e2e/e2e_test.go.

Acceptance criteria covered here (verbatim):
- The e2e suite has one shared helper that wires the app on a fresh test database and drops it when the test ends. It replaces `newClient`'s in-memory wiring and the per-file copies of the "own database" helper.
- `GET /api/health` behaves exactly as before (TestHealth, now on MongoDB).

Domain term: *Test database*: a MongoDB database created for one test and dropped when it ends, on the server named by `MONGO_TEST_URI`. Each test that needs MongoDB uses its own test database, because parallel agents share one server.

Implement exactly this API. The names and signatures are a contract, because other tasks code against them in parallel:
- `generousLimits() middleware.RateLimitConfig`: unchanged.
- `e2eMongoURI(t *testing.T) string`: returns MONGO_TEST_URI. If it is unset, call t.Fatal with "MONGO_TEST_URI is not set: the e2e tests run against MongoDB. Run `make mongo`, then `export MONGO_TEST_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017`". Never t.Skip.
- `e2eConfig(uri, dbName string) bootstrap.Config`: returns `bootstrap.Config{Storage: bootstrap.StorageMongo, MongoURI: uri, MongoDB: dbName, RateLimit: generousLimits()}`. This is the only place in backend/e2e that names the storage. Its doc comment says that S03-08 removes the Storage field once bootstrap has no storage setting.
- `e2eTestDB(t *testing.T) (name string, db *mongo.Database)`: the name is "test_" plus the hex of 8 bytes from crypto/rand. The handle comes from one package-level client that all tests share. Connect it lazily, once (e.g. sync.OnceValues), with `mongodb.Connect` from orch-test/backend/internal/platform/mongodb and MONGO_TEST_URI. If the connection fails, call t.Fatalf with the error; never print the URI's credentials. No test ever disconnects it. Nothing is created up front, because MongoDB creates the database on the first write (bootstrap.New's migrations). t.Cleanup drops the database with a 10 s timeout and reports a failed drop with t.Errorf.
- `e2eMongoConfig(t *testing.T) (bootstrap.Config, *mongo.Database)`: takes a database from e2eTestDB and returns `e2eConfig(e2eMongoURI(t), name)` plus the handle.
- `type e2eEnv struct { URL string; Client *oas.Client; App *bootstrap.App; DB *mongo.Database; Config bootstrap.Config }`
- `e2eServe(t *testing.T, cfg bootstrap.Config, db *mongo.Database) e2eEnv`: calls bootstrap.New(context.Background(), cfg) (t.Fatalf on error), starts an httptest server on app.Handler and creates the generated oas client. Its t.Cleanup closes the server, then the app (5 s timeout). It uses cfg exactly as given, so a zero RateLimit means the production default limits.
- `e2eStart(t *testing.T) e2eEnv`: e2eServe on a fresh e2eMongoConfig(t).
- `newClient(t *testing.T) *oas.Client`: returns e2eStart(t).Client. The name and signature stay.

Notes:
- Cleanup order: e2eMongoConfig registers the drop before e2eServe registers the close, so the app is closed before its database is dropped.
- Give each helper a short doc comment, matching the file's style.
- Don't edit the other e2e files. They keep their own helpers until S03-04 to S03-07 switch them, and they must still compile. Use grep to make sure no new identifier clashes with an existing one in package e2e_test.
- Run backend/check.sh with MONGO_TEST_URI set. It must pass.

title: Replace the memory adapter in catalog/app tests with a test double
prompt:
Story S-03 deletes backend/internal/catalog/adapter/memory (in S03-08). Today the catalog/app unit tests use it as their repository. Replace it with a test double, so that application unit tests keep running without MongoDB.

Acceptance criterion (verbatim): `catalog/app` unit tests (`service_test.go`, `seed_test.go`) use a test double in the `app` package's test files, and coverage of `catalog/app` and `catalog/domain` stays at 80% or more.

Domain terms and rules (verbatim from the story):
- *Test double*: a fake repository inside a test file, used by application-layer unit tests. It is not a storage and isn't wired anywhere.
- Domain and application unit tests still run without MongoDB. They use test doubles defined in their own `_test.go` files, not an adapter.

Do:
1. Add backend/internal/catalog/app/repository_double_test.go in package app_test, the same package as service_test.go. It defines an unexported `fakeRepository` that implements `domain.Repository` (backend/internal/catalog/domain/repository.go), plus `newFakeRepository() *fakeRepository`. The service tests rely on the port's documented contract, so the fake must honor it:
   - Add ignores b.ID and assigns the next ID: > 0, increasing, never reused, starting at 1. If another book has the ISBN, it returns ErrDuplicateISBN and stores nothing.
   - Get and FindByISBN return ErrNotFound.
   - List returns the books matching the ListFilter (exact author match), sorted by ID ascending and paged by Page. The slice is never nil, and the total counts all matches.
   - Update returns ErrNotFound, or ErrVersionConflict if the stored version isn't expectedVersion, or ErrDuplicateISBN if another book has b.ISBN. On error it changes nothing.
   - Remove returns ErrNotFound.
   - Deep-copy books on the way in and out (the Authors slice and pointer fields), and guard the state with a mutex.
   You may port the logic of backend/internal/catalog/adapter/memory/repository.go. Read it, but don't import or modify it.
2. In service_test.go and seed_test.go, replace every `memory.NewRepository()` with `newFakeRepository()` and drop the memory import. The wrapper doubles (racingRepo, addErrRepo, findErrRepo) keep embedding a repository, which is now the fake.
3. Production code in app and domain doesn't change. Every test keeps its assertions.
4. Use grep to confirm that nothing in backend/internal/catalog/app imports adapter/memory any more.
5. Run backend/check.sh with MONGO_TEST_URI set. Coverage of catalog/app and catalog/domain must stay at 80% or more.

title: Require MONGO_TEST_URI in check.sh and fail instead of skipping MongoDB tests
prompt:
Story S-03: from now on every test that needs MongoDB requires it. No test skips because MONGO_TEST_URI is missing.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim):
- Given `MONGO_TEST_URI` is unset, when `backend/check.sh` runs, then it exits non-zero before running any test, with a message naming `make mongo` and `MONGO_TEST_URI`.
- The repository contract suite (`adapter/repotest`) still exists and runs against the MongoDB repository.
Rule: `backend/check.sh` **requires** `MONGO_TEST_URI`. No test skips because MongoDB is missing.

Make exactly these changes:
1. backend/check.sh: right after the `cd "$(dirname "$0")"` line and before the first step, add:
   if [ -z "${MONGO_TEST_URI:-}" ]; then
     echo "MONGO_TEST_URI is not set. The backend tests run against MongoDB:"
     echo "  make mongo"
     echo "  export MONGO_TEST_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017"
     exit 1
   fi
   Update the header comment to say the checks need MongoDB at MONGO_TEST_URI. Nothing else in check.sh changes.
2. backend/internal/catalog/adapter/mongodb/testdb_test.go and backend/internal/platform/mongodb/testdb_test.go: when MONGO_TEST_URI is unset, newTestDB calls t.Fatal instead of t.Skip, with the message "MONGO_TEST_URI is not set: run `make mongo`, then `export MONGO_TEST_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017`". In its doc comment, change "or skips the test" to say it fails the test. Nothing else in those packages changes.
3. backend/internal/catalog/adapter/repotest/repotest.go: change only the doc comment that says the factory "may call t.Skip (MongoDB without MONGO_TEST_URI)", so that it says the factory may register cleanups. No code change.
4. Verify both ways: `MONGO_TEST_URI= backend/check.sh` exits 1 with the message before `go generate` runs, and backend/check.sh with MONGO_TEST_URI set passes.
Don't touch the Makefile, the docs, the bootstrap tests or the e2e tests. Other tasks own them.

title: Make bootstrap MongoDB-only and delete the memory adapter
prompt:
Story S-03: MongoDB becomes the only storage. Everything that used the memory storage has already been switched: S03-02 gave the catalog/app tests a test double, and S03-04 to S03-07 moved the e2e tests to the shared MongoDB helper. Now remove the storage setting and the memory adapter.

Domain rules (verbatim from the story):
- *Storage*: where repositories keep their data. After this story there is only one, MongoDB, so there is no setting to choose it.
- The server always connects to MongoDB and runs the migrations before serving. There is no storage setting any more: `STORAGE` is gone from the code, and the server ignores it if set.
- `MONGO_URI` defaults to `mongodb://localhost:27017` and `MONGO_DB` to `orch`, so `make mongo && make backend` works without setting anything.
- If MongoDB can't be reached at startup, the server exits with an error naming the URI (without credentials), and it never starts serving.
- **The MongoDB storage itself stays as it is**: its adapter, migrations, schema and behavior don't change.

Acceptance criteria (verbatim; S03-09 adds the e2e tests, you write the unit tests):
- `backend/internal/catalog/adapter/memory/` no longer exists, and no Go code imports it.
- `bootstrap.Config` has no storage field, and `bootstrap.ConfigFromEnv` doesn't read `STORAGE`. `bootstrap.New` always connects to MongoDB and migrates before it returns.
- Given `MONGO_URI` and `MONGO_DB` are unset, then the server connects to `mongodb://localhost:27017` and uses database `orch`.
- Given MongoDB is unreachable, when the server starts, then it exits with a non-zero status and an error naming the URI, within the connect timeout. Credentials in the URI are not printed.
- Given `STORAGE=memory` is still set in someone's environment, when the server starts, then it ignores the setting and uses MongoDB.
- `internal/archtest` passes unchanged.

1. backend/internal/bootstrap/bootstrap.go
   - Delete the `Storage` type, `StorageMemory`, `StorageMongo` and `Config.Storage`. Config keeps MongoURI, MongoDB, SeedDemoData, RateLimit and Logger.
   - ConfigFromEnv reads MONGO_URI (default mongodb://localhost:27017), MONGO_DB (default orch) and SEED_DEMO_DATA. It never reads STORAGE. Update its doc comment.
   - New: if cfg.MongoURI or cfg.MongoDB is empty, return an error ("bootstrap: MongoURI and MongoDB are required"). Otherwise always call mongodb.Connect. On failure return `fmt.Errorf("connect to MongoDB at %s: %w", redactMongoURI(cfg.MongoURI), err)`. Then migrate, set h.Ping and build catalogmongo.NewRepository(db), exactly as the mongo branch does today. Remove the memory import and the switch. Update the doc comments; the wiring example becomes `h.TodoHandler = todohttp.NewTodoHandler(todoapp.NewService(todomongodb.NewRepository(db)))`.
   - Add an unexported `redactMongoURI(raw string) string`. It runs url.Parse and returns "(unparsable MongoDB URI)" on error. Otherwise it keeps the scheme, host list and path, and drops the userinfo, query and fragment. Example: "mongodb://alice:s3cret@db.example:27017/admin?authSource=admin" becomes "mongodb://db.example:27017/admin".
   - Don't change internal/platform/mongodb. Connect's 2 s ping already bounds the startup.
2. Delete backend/internal/catalog/adapter/memory/ (repository.go, repository_test.go, contract_test.go). The repotest contract suite keeps running against MongoDB in adapter/mongodb/repository_test.go. Use grep to confirm that no Go file imports .../catalog/adapter/memory. archtest's synthetic `todo/adapter/memory` paths stay, and archtest is never modified.
3. Bootstrap tests (bootstrap_test.go, bootstrap_catalog_mongo_test.go; new _test.go files are allowed):
   - Add a helper for a fresh test database on MONGO_TEST_URI: a "test_<random hex>" name, dropped in t.Cleanup. If MONGO_TEST_URI is unset, it calls t.Fatal with "run `make mongo`, then `export MONGO_TEST_URI=mongodb://localhost:27017`". Never t.Skip.
   - Replace TestNewWithMemoryStorageMakesNoMongoConnection with TestNewFailsWhenMongoIsUnreachable: `New(ctx, Config{MongoURI: "mongodb://alice:s3cret@127.0.0.1:1/?authSource=admin", MongoDB: "orch"})` returns a nil App and an error within 10 s. The error contains "mongodb://127.0.0.1:1/" and contains neither "alice" nor "s3cret".
   - Add a table test for redactMongoURI: with and without credentials, several hosts ("mongodb://u:p@a:1,b:2/db?replicaSet=rs"), mongodb+srv, and unparsable input.
   - Test that New with an empty MongoURI or MongoDB returns an error.
   - ConfigFromEnv: MONGO_URI and MONGO_DB set to "" give the defaults; set values are used as given; with STORAGE=memory set, the result equals the result without it.
   - newMemoryApp becomes an app on a fresh test database. TestNewWithoutSeedingLeavesTheCatalogEmpty asserted an empty log, but on MongoDB the migrations log, so assert instead that there is no "seeded" line. TestNewSeedsTheDemoCatalog keeps its assertions.
   - TestNewWithMongoStorageMigrates and TestNewWithMongoStorageStoresBooksInMongo: drop the Storage field and the skip. You may also drop "WithMongoStorage" from the names.
4. backend/cmd/server/main.go: drop `"storage", cfg.Storage` from the "listening" log. Never log MONGO_URI; the database name is fine. A bootstrap error still makes run return it and main exit 1, before anything listens. Add a test to main_test.go: with MONGO_URI=mongodb://alice:s3cret@127.0.0.1:1/, MONGO_DB=orch and STORAGE=memory (t.Setenv), run("127.0.0.1:0") returns an error within 10 s. title: Add e2e tests for MongoDB-only startup
prompt:

- bootstrap.Config has the fields MongoURI, MongoDB, SeedDemoData, RateLimit and Logger, and no Storage field.
- ConfigFromEnv reads MONGO_URI (default mongodb://localhost:27017), MONGO_DB (default orch) and SEED_DEMO_DATA.
